svg.text: DS1 - Forgot password and reset the password
FORGOT PASSWORD AND RESET THE PASSWORD
Type my email address and submit
Ask the server to send a reset link
Look up the account by email address
[there is no account with this email address]
[the account is blocked or the email is not verified]
Show the error message on the form
[the account may ask for a reset]
Remove any previous reset token of this user
Save a new reset token valid for 30 minutes
The reset link has been sent
Open the reset link from the inbox
Check whether the reset token is usable
Find the token of type RESET_PASSWORD
the token may be unknown, used or expired
(400 BAD_REQUEST "The link is invalid or has expired")
and count down to the sign-in page
and count down to the new-password page
Type the new password twice and submit
Check the form and re-check the token
Reset password(token, new password, confirm new password)
Reset the password of the user
Look up the account of the token
[the account is blocked or the email is not verified]
and count down to the sign-in page
"Password reset successfully!" and count down to the sign-in page
